description: Read the full text of a cooking guide from recipes-daily.com, as markdown. Call this when search_recipes lists a guide that answers the question — how or why something works in the kitchen, how to store or substitute an ingredient, how to use a piece of equipment — and answer from what it says rather than from memory, citing its URL. Pass the guide URL exactly as search_recipes returned it. For recipes, use show_recipes instead: a recipe is a page the person cooks from, not text to retell.

guide.description: The guide to read, as the absolute recipes-daily.com URL search_recipes returned — e.g. "https://recipes-daily.com/guides/preparations/why-do-dried-beans-take-so-long-to-cook".

name: read_guide
title: Read a cooking guide
